{#- Small line icons, drawn on a 24 grid with a 1.8 stroke like the app's own (DESIGN.md §7). -#} {% macro icon(name) -%} {%- endmacro icon %} {#- A command's default shortcuts as keycaps, from the generated command table: both systems are written and the page shows the reader's. `all` shows every default chord, otherwise the first. -#} {% macro keycaps(command, all=false) -%} {%- for chord in command.keys %}{% if all or loop.first -%} {%- set mac = command.keys_mac[loop.index0] -%} {%- if not loop.first %}or{% endif -%} {%- for cap in chord %}{% set other = mac[loop.index0] %}{% if other == cap %}{{ cap }}{% else %}{{ cap }}{{ other }}{% endif %}{% endfor -%} {%- endif %}{% endfor -%} {%- endmacro keycaps %}
